notes.title: Hotfix Update 1.1
notes.notes:
Trace Hunters v1.1 is now live for everyone. This hotfix addresses a controller drift issue that was affecting some players, making it very difficult for them to play the game.

Selected changes:
- Controller drift for Xbox 360 controllers is resolved. PS5 controller support is unchanged.
- Minor weapon description update for Cluster Mines
- The Unlock Point progress bar now correctly displays progress to the next Unlock Point
- One too many Unlock Points were granted upon reaching max level. This has been resolved and the max level will correctly display.

Thank you for playing Trace Hunters!

notes.title: Demo Update 02-26
notes.notes:
The demo version of Trace Hunters has seen some more updates just in time for the Dinos vs. Robots fest. These are small, but hopefully noticeable changes primarily focused on the enemy AI.

Instead of sitting around waiting for you to destroy them, the drones in the demo will respond to attack you more aggressively. In addition you'll find:


 Updated animations on the shield
 More sounds across all actions in the game
 Some touch ups to the environment to help it flow better.


Enjoy the festival and thanks for playing!

notes.title: Small Demo Build Update
notes.notes:
I just published a small update to the demo build to include a quality of life feature.

It adds a prompt to reset the vehicle in case you are stuck on your back and don't know the correct input to flip yourself over.

Hope you enjoy the demo!

notes.title: First Demo Version Available!
notes.notes:
The first demo for Trace Hunters is now live! In this demo, you will play through an early, shorter level of the game. The demo is single player and does not include additional weapons.

The game is not feature complete at this point, but at a stage where you can get a feeling for combat and have fun blasting robots! When Trace Hunters progresses to a more feature complete state, I will publish an updated demo with additional content, so keep watch.
